recentItems.title: Hey Babe!' FULL MOVIE (Digitally Restored) | Jolina Magdangal, Marvin Agustin
recentItems.description:
Abigail (Jolina Magdangal) religiously consults Madame Lola (Gina Pareño), a fortune teller. Madame Lola takes advantage of Abigail’s belief in superstition by giving her false signs in her search for Mr. Right, all favoring Nelson (Marvin Agustin) who’s in love with Abigail. Released in 1999 and directed by Joyce Bernal.

Starring Jolina Magdangal, Marvin Agustin, Alma Moreno, and Gina Pareño.

recentItems.title: 'Ang Tanging Ina N’yong Lahat’ FULL MOVIE (Digitally Restored) | Ai Ai delas Alas
recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Ang Tanging Ina’ FULL MOVIE (Digitally Restored) | Ai Ai delas Alas, Eugene Domingo
recentItems.description:
Ina Montecillo (Ai Ai delas Alas), who’s been widowed three times, is left to take care of her 12 children. To make ends meet, she takes up various odd jobs, ending up as an entertainer in a nightclub. Fearing her children’s reaction, she hides the truth from them. Released in 2003 and directed by Wenn V. Deramas.

Starring Ai Ai delas Alas, Eugene Domingo, Marvin Agustin, and Heart Evangelista.
